purpose.primary: Advance science through results that can be independently checked, reproduced, falsified, and reused.
purpose.secondary: Help develop technologies that help people by producing methods whose correctness does not depend on trust in the author.
not_the_goal: A dramatic P=NP announcement at any cost
A benchmark-only success without a theorem or exact scoped certificate
Protecting a favored hypothesis from falsification

trustless_science_principle.formal_statement: A scientific TRUMP claim should remain checkable even by a reviewer who assumes the authors may be mistaken.
trustless_science_principle.publication_target: A skeptical external researcher should be able to reconstruct the exact claim from frozen source, rerun the verifier, inspect the certificate, reproduce the complexity argument, and obtain the same scoped conclusion.

technology_service_principle.goal: Prefer research outputs that can become dependable building blocks for technologies that help people.
technology_service_principle.requirement: Utility never overrides correctness; a useful technology must inherit explicit assumptions, failure modes, verification rules, and reproducible evidence.

reviewer_test.question: Can an independent skeptical researcher reject every metaphor and personal claim, execute only the formal specification and certificates, and still reach the same result?
reviewer_test.fail_condition: If trust in the author, analogy, intuition, hidden state, undocumented manual choice, or unavailable evidence is required, the scientific package is incomplete.

canonical_seal.ru: Цель TRUMP — не добиться желаемого ответа, а построить результат, который можно не принимать на веру и всё равно независимо проверить. Истина важнее желаемого результата; воспроизводимость важнее впечатляющего заявления. Отрицательные результаты, контрпримеры и узкие границы теорем сохраняются, а не маскируются. Разработка должна двигать науку и создавать надёжные основания для технологий, которые помогают людям.
canonical_seal.en: TRUMP must be built so that nobody needs to trust us in order to verify us. Truth outranks the desired result; reproducibility outranks impressiveness; falsifiers and negative results are preserved; every promotion is scoped and independently checkable. The purpose is to advance science and provide trustworthy foundations for technologies that help people.
